steps.message:
The build passes. Note: `git diff` is empty here only because this working copy lives under a `runs/` path that the outer repo gitignores — the edits are on disk.

## Diagnosis

Both crashes trace to `ManualEntryDialog`'s Save handler:

```java
int period = Integer.parseInt(periodInput.getText().toString());  // line 172 → NumberFormatException on ""
int digits = Integer.parseInt(digitsInput.getText().toString());
...
e.updateOTP();   // line 176 → ArithmeticException: divide by zero (Entry.java:300, time / getPeriod())
```

The root cause is that the dialog's `TextWatcher` only validated `labelInput` and `secretInput`. The advanced-options fields (`manual_period`, `manual_digits`) had no watcher attached and no validation at all, so the Save button stayed enabled with `""` or `"0"` in them, and the unguarded `parseInt` / `period`-division ran on garbage.

## Fix

**`ManualEntryDialog.java`**
- The `TextWatcher` now delegates to a new `validateInput(...)` that checks all four fields, and it is also registered on `periodInput` and `digitsInput` (previously only label/secret). It's invoked once after `dialog.show()` to set the initial button state.
- `validatePositiveNumber(...)` rejects empty values and anything that isn't an integer greater than zero, calling `EditText.setError(...)` so the offending field shows *why* it's invalid — matching the "Expected result" in the report — and clearing the error once the value is valid.
- `parsePositiveInt(EditText, int)` replaces the bare `Integer.parseInt` calls in the Save handler, falling back to `TOTP_DEFAULT_PERIOD` / the type-appropriate digits default (`STEAM_DEFAULT_DIGITS` for Steam, `TOTP_DEFAULT_DIGITS` otherwise). With validation in place this path is unreachable, but it guarantees no `NumberFormatException` or zero period can ever reach `Entry.updateOTP()`.

**`res/values/strings_main.xml`** — added four translatable error strings (`error_empty_period`, `error_invalid_period`, `error_empty_digits`, `error_invalid_digits`). Only the default locale is touched; other locales fall back to English as usual.

Now with an empty or `0` period/digits the Save button is disabled and the field displays an inline error, instead of the app crashing. Existing behavior (valid entries, Steam type auto-filling and disabling the fields, label/secret emptiness checks) is unchanged — disabled Steam fields still hold valid defaults, so they validate cleanly.
